title: UK Measures of National Well-being Dashboard
meta_description: An overview of well-being in the UK on an individual, community and national level. Considers change across 59 measures of well-being, grouped by 10 topic areas.

breadcrumb.text: Measuring progress, well-being and beyond GDP
UK Measures of National Well-being Dashboard

lede: An overview of well-being in the UK on an individual, community and national level. Considers change across 59 measures of well-being, grouped by 10 topic areas.

body.text: We are moving from updating the UK Measures of National Well-being (UKMNW) Dashboard quarterly to updating it annually, starting in June 2026.

Changes in estimates are displayed over the short term. This is defined as the latest estimate compared with five years ago for Protected areas, Priority species, Air pollution and Surface water status. For Healthy life expectancy, Unhappy partner relationships and Depression or Anxiety it is defined as the latest estimate compared with the closest non-overlapping period. Short-term change for all other measures is assessed as the latest estimate compared with one year ago. For more information on our methods, please see our [UK Measures of National Well-being framework user guide](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/wellbeing/methodologies/ukmeasuresofnationalwellbeinguserguide).

[UK Measures of National Well-being framework user guide](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/wellbeing/methodologies/ukmeasuresofnationalwellbeinguserguide) 
User guide| Released on 8 June 2026 
User guide for the UK Measures of National Well-being, providing more detail on the framework. Includes metadata tables of the measures, detail on how we produce estimates, and measure change over time.

[Beyond GDP insights, measures of National Well-being: June 2026](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/wellbeing/bulletins/measuringprogresswellbeingandbeyondgdpintheuk/june2026) 
Bulletin | Released on 8 June 2026 
Exploring quality of life and progress beyond GDP in the UK, drawing on the 60 national well-being measures.

[Quarterly personal well-being statistics, May 2026](https://www.ons.gov.uk/releases/quarterlypersonalwellbeingstatisticsmay2026) 
Dataset | Released on 28 May 2026 
Non-seasonally adjusted and seasonally adjusted quarterly estimates of life satisfaction, feeling that the things done in life are worthwhile, happiness and anxiety in the UK.
